Burnfeed 2.0 — October 2026

  • A fresh look: Burnfeed's popup and settings feel at home on your Mac, in light and dark.
  • Where a feed was, a quote now sits quietly in the site's own colors.
  • Burning and pausing take effect instantly, in every open tab, without reloading.
  • Show a feed for 5, 15 or 60 minutes, or pause everything; it burns again on its own.
  • Choose how a burned feed looks: gone, frosted, ashes, redacted or faded.
  • Pick exactly what goes on each site, from YouTube comments and suggested videos to X's trending panel, right from the toolbar button.
  • Burned feeds stop loading in the background, so pages are lighter and you can't scroll into an empty feed.
  • When a site changes its layout, fixes arrive on their own, no update needed. If Burnfeed can't find a feed, it tells you and lets you report it in one click.
  • Your settings and quotes from earlier versions come with you.
